patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Amplemarket and ZoomInfo share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Comparison thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Amplemarket only if your buying job matches “AI-powered multichannel outbound platform combining lead intelligence, sequences, delivera” rather than ZoomInfo's shape. Choose ZoomInfo only if your buying job matches “Enterprise go-to-market intelligence platform for B2B contact/company data, enrichment, in” rather than Amplemarket's shape. Workflow advantage: Amplemarket leans sales-engagement, email-outreach; ZoomInfo leans data-enrichment, lead-management. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Amplemarket and ZoomInfo share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Amplemarket is AI-powered multichannel outbound platform combining lead intelligence, sequences, deliverability, and Duo AI assistants.; ZoomInfo is Enterprise go-to-market intelligence platform for B2B contact/company data, enrichment, intent, and Copilot workflows — custom-quote packagi.
- Workflow coverage skew: Amplemarket-leaning sales-engagement, email-outreach vs ZoomInfo-leaning data-enrichment, lead-management.
- Researched limits: Amplemarket — Not a full CRM pipeline system of record.; ZoomInfo — Main platform seat prices are not published — packaging is custom quote.

Limitations — Amplemarket: Not a full CRM pipeline system of record.; Startup already $600/mo annual; Growth/Elite are custom-quoted.; ZoomInfo: Main platform seat prices are not published — packaging is custom quote; Credit consumption on export (CSV/CRM/API) requires ongoing governance.

Poor-fit cases: Amplemarket is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a full CRM pipeline system of record. · ZoomInfo is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Main platform seat prices are not published — packaging is custom quote · Avoid Amplemarket if you actually need ZoomInfo's motion (Enterprise go-to-market intelligence platform for B2B contact/company data, enri)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
